component.name: SmartScope
component.summary: Oscilloscope, logic analyzer and waveform generator

description.p: SmartScope is the companion application for the LabNation SmartScope, a USB-connected 100MS/s oscilloscope, logic analyzer and arbitrary waveform generator. It offers touch-friendly waveform navigation, protocol decoders, measurements and data export, and can also connect to a SmartScope shared over the network by the bundled SmartScope Server.
This is an unofficial flatpak packaging of the last Linux release (0.15.1.0) published by LabNation. The proprietary application itself is downloaded from lab-nation.com during installation.
